id.description: This is the unique identifier for the profile or user.

createdAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the profile was last updated.

email.description: This is the email of the user that is associated with the profile.

fullName.description: This is the full name of the user that is associated with the profile.
